name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (gfx render). Name accurately reflects purpose: render the corner terrain-info HUD panel (terrain icon + MV/DEF modifiers, plus the cursor unit's portrait + HP). No Ghidra address residue in the name. 'terrain_info' and 'hud_panel' match the body's gate, layout, and modifier rendering.
purpose: Render the corner 'terrain info' HUD panel on battle-UI repaint: shows the tile under the cursor (terrain icon, MV/DEF modifiers) and, when a non-hidden unit stands there, that unit's portrait and HP.
logic_summary: Gate: returns immediately unless both HUD-enable flags (data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled, data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag) are set. Auto-positions the panel column to avoid covering the cursor: latches data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_panel_offset_51a0c to 0xF2 when cursor_screen_y>5 && cursor_screen_x<3, to 1 when cursor_screen_y>5 && cursor_screen_x>9, else keeps the previous value. Computes panel_base = buf + stride*0x9D + latched_offset. Blits the panel backdrop (anim sheet + *(sheet+0x20E)) via fd2_rle_blit_sprite. Reads the cursor tile's attributes into an 8-byte local via fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos: word[0] indexes data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot for the 24x24 terrain icon (blitted at +stride*5+6), byte[5] indexes the MV/DEF per-tile modifier tables drawn as signed glyphs at +stride*8+0x2B and +stride*0x13+0x2B. Then fd2_find_char_at_cursor_pos(): if a unit is present (idx != -1) and not hidden (portrait_id != 0x79) and not an archetype-10 team-1 enemy, computes frame_mod from chapter ambient palette idx (==3 -> 1), fetches the portrait from the portrait cache (cache + *(cache + (frame_mod + sprite_state[0]*0xC)*4)), overwrites the terrain icon with the portrait at +stride*5+6, and draws HP/HP_max as 3 digits (red glow when full) at +stride*0x15+9.

params.name: buf
params.semantics: Destination render workspace base linear address. Callers pass the battle composite back-buffer (e.g. data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + 0x8088). panel_base is derived as buf + stride*0x9D + latched_offset.
params.reason: Accurately denotes the destination buffer base; no address residue. Generic but correct and consistent with sibling renderers in this file.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Render pitch (bytes per row) of the destination surface. fd2_composite_battle_frame passes 0x1C8 (456, the wider scrolling workspace pitch). Used as the row multiplier throughout the layout.
params.reason: Correct, standard pitch/stride name used consistently across the gfx renderers; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. The binary reaches its RET via a JMP into a shared register-restore epilogue (JMP 0x1317d), behaviourally a plain return.
